title: Pre-Intermediate Final Test
subtitle: Cumulative · Units 1–9 · the whole course in one exam

sections.title: A. Complete the sentences with the correct form of the verbs in brackets.

items.q: I ______ (go) to the dentist yesterday.
We ______ (play) chess when Mum came home.
If I won a lot of money, I ______ (buy) a house for my parents.
I ______ (meet) Sara at 5 p.m. today — we arranged it yesterday.
She ______ (already / finish) her project.
The pyramids ______ (build) thousands of years ago.
When I arrived, the film ______ (already / start).
If Aziz passes the test, his parents ______ (be) very happy.
There isn’t ___ milk in the fridge.
You ___ use your phone during the exam. It’s against the rules.
This is the ___ day of the year!
Look at those clouds! It ___ rain.
He said he ___ come to the party.

sections.title: C. Complete the second sentence so that it has the same meaning. Use 1–3 words.

items.q: It isn’t necessary to bring food. → You ______ bring food.
The bag is too heavy for me to carry. → The bag isn’t light ______ me to carry.
No mountain in Uzbekistan is higher than this one. → This is ______ mountain in Uzbekistan.
People grow cotton here. → Cotton ______ here.
I don’t know her number, so I can’t call her. → If I ______ her number, I could call her.
‘I’m busy,’ said Lola. → Lola said she ______ busy.
I moved here in 2019. → I ______ here since 2019.

sections.title: G. Rewrite the sentences. Use the word in brackets. Write only the missing part.

items.q: I’m tired because I worked all day. → I worked all day, ______ tired. (so)
It was raining. We played football. → ______ it was raining, we played football. (although)
Let’s go to the park. → ______ going to the park? (How about)
I think you should rest. → Why ______ rest? (don’t)
I prefer to stay at home. → I’d ______ stay at home. (rather)
‘I’ll call you,’ he said. → He said he ______ me. (would)
The museum was crowded. We enjoyed it. → The museum was crowded. ______, we enjoyed it. (nevertheless)
She’s very rich. She isn’t happy. → ______ she’s very rich, she isn’t happy. (even though)
Can you repair my phone? → Can my phone ______? (be)
I agree with you up to a point. → I agree to some ______. (extent)

sections.title: Listening. Listen to two friends talking about their plans after school. Choose the correct answers.
sections.script:
Bekzod: Zarina, have you decided what you're going to do after school?
Zarina: I think so. I'm going to apply to a university in Tashkent to study tourism. I'd love to work as a tour guide in Samarkand.
Bekzod: That sounds great. Your English is really good, too.
Zarina: Thanks! I've been studying for six years. What about you?
Bekzod: I'm not sure really. My parents want me to be a doctor, but I'm not very keen on biology. If I could choose anything, I'd study computer science.
Zarina: Why don't you talk to them? They might understand.
Bekzod: Maybe. Although they're strict, they always listen in the end.
Zarina: And you've already built that app for our school library. That's real experience!
Bekzod: You're right. OK — I'll talk to them this weekend.

items.q: What does Zarina want to study?
How long has Zarina been studying English?
What do Bekzod's parents want him to be?
What has Bekzod already made?
o: An app for the school library

items.q: What does Bekzod decide to do?
o: Talk to his parents this weekend

sections.title: H. Read the text and choose the correct answers.
sections.passage:
Wanted: Young Guides for Summer Tours in Khiva

Are you 16–19, friendly and good at English? Every summer thousands of tourists visit the old city of Khiva, and we need young people to show them around.

You don’t need any experience — we will give you two weeks of training in history and guiding. However, you must be able to speak English confidently, and a second foreign language is a big advantage.

Guides work four days a week, from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m., because the afternoons are too hot for walking tours. You will earn a good salary, plus tips from tourists, and the best guide of the summer will win a trip to Istanbul.

To apply, send a short video in English (no longer than two minutes) telling us why you love Khiva. Applications close on 1 May.

items.q: Who is the advert for?
What will the company give new guides?
Why do the tours finish at 1 p.m.?
o: It is too hot in the afternoon.

items.q: What must you send to apply?
What can the best guide win?
